header.description: Apply a previously fitted DAS rotation on the test split instead of re-computing it: the featurizer's file_path loads the artifact, and its ArtifactIdentity (model, site, k, parametrization, dtype) is checked on load - a mismatch refuses. 'entry' names which fit to apply: against this single-bundle artifact it is documentation, but the same document loaded against a swept fit's bundle (one entry per k x seed point) is how one rotation is picked out. No train section; a featurizer with file_path may not appear in train.params. The dtype is declared because model_dtype is part of that identity and a 'model' block without one implies fp32 - so an apply document that omits it is refused [V15] against a bf16 fit, which is what weekdays_das_sweep.json is. The --dtype flag is a --set shorthand and lands in the document, but the mismatch a reader hits is usually a file that never carried the field.
